List your agents, or with SANDBOX the runs in it

Usage: cua agent ls [OPTIONS] [SANDBOX]

Arguments:
  [SANDBOX]
          Sandbox (`local:NAME`, `direct:HOST:PORT`, or NAME). Without it: your named agents

Options:
      --local
          Look NAME up among local sandboxes only (same as `local:NAME`)

      --embedded
          Use an embedded runtime even when a daemon runs

      --daemon <DAEMON>
          Daemon address (socket path or loopback URL)
          
          [env: CUA_DAEMON=]

      --daemon-token <DAEMON_TOKEN>
          Daemon token (loopback URLs)
          
          [env: CUA_DAEMON_TOKEN]

      --state-dir <STATE_DIR>
          Sandbox state directory (embedded; default ~/.cua/sandboxes)

      --json
          Print JSON

  -h, --help
          Print help

Examples:
  cua agent ls
  cua agent ls local:dev
